title: Gateway refText re-validation contract
contractLabel: DRAFT_CONSUMER_EXPECTATION — a Frontend consumer expectation, UNBOUND to any provider SHA. NOT a canonical contract, NOT live data, grants no authority.
note: This fixture is the machine-readable contract the sibling Gateway session must satisfy. Passing conformance here proves ONLY Frontend shape-compatibility; it does NOT mark the Gateway VERIFIED.

contract.requirement: At submit, the Gateway MUST re-resolve any server-issued refText / '@file:' reference against the AUTHENTICATED workspace. The client-supplied refText is a reference only, never authority.
contract.rationale: The client cannot be trusted to bind a reference to a file; the server re-resolves ownership + scan state in the caller's workspace so a stale or forged refText cannot smuggle another workspace's file.
